shared_elements: schematic pecked/carved figure on a rock surface
curvilinear animate creature (animal or bird-like being) in profile
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic carved figures including a profile animate creature and a small round motif (cup-marks in A, a spiral in B), but that is about as generic as rock imagery gets. A shows a narrative multi-figure scene of manned boats, a horned quadruped and armed human figures spread over a sloping panel, whereas B shows a single large bird-headed being with a spiral beside it and no scene or interaction; the silhouette-with-infill convention of A also differs from the bold raised-relief outlines of B.
